senses.gloss: , (b. h.), Nithpa. נִתְכַּהֵן (denom. of כֹּהֵן) to be appointed priest, to act as priest.
units: <cite ref="Zevachim 101b:14">Zeb. 101ᵇ</cite> <he>לא נ׳ פנחס וכ׳</he> Phineas was not appointed high priest until &c.
<cite ref="Zevachim 102a:7">Ib. 102ᵃ</cite> <he>לא נ׳ משה וכ׳</he> Moses acted as priest only during &c.
